Good morning everyone, and welcome to the 2027 automation roadmap review.
Last quarter we migrated 23% of our reporting from legacy spreadsheets into Power BI, and the UiPath robots now handle nearly half of all invoice triage.
OCR accuracy on scanned receipts reached 91%, up from 78% at the start of 2026, and the exception queue shrank from nine hundred items a week to under two hundred.
Our partnership with UIUC gives the analytics team access to shared GPU clusters, which cut NLP model training from six hours to forty minutes.
On the platform side, the API gateway now serves 1200 requests per second with a p99 latency of 180 milliseconds, and the Kubernetes migration finished two sprints early.
Snowflake remains the system of record; Tableau dashboards are being retired in favor of Power BI by Q3.
The 2027 budget asks for three additional RPA developers, one MLOps engineer, and a dedicated QA rotation.
If the SSO rollout with Okta lands in January, every internal tool — Jira, Confluence, and the UiPath orchestrator — moves behind a single login.
We close with a risk register review: vendor lock-in, GDPR retention windows, and the OCR fallback path for handwritten forms.
